subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should OpenClaw keep expanding built-in skill frontmatter descriptions with concrete trigger phrases, or preserve short descriptions and move trigger semantics to a separate structured direction such as the open triggers-field proposal?
rationale: Current code still uses description as a routing signal, but current docs and skill-authoring guidance intentionally keep descriptions compact, so automation cannot pick the permanent policy safely.

options.title: Use short trigger-critical descriptions
options.body: Allow targeted edits where a bundled skill's one-line description lacks essential routing signal, but keep descriptions compact and avoid stuffing full trigger lists into frontmatter.

options.title: Adopt structured trigger metadata
options.body: Pause broad description edits and route the permanent fix through the open triggers-field design so descriptions stay readable while routing gets explicit keywords.

options.title: Supersede this broad audit
options.body: Close or consolidate this issue under the narrower current audit and structured-trigger issue after preserving the useful examples and deciding what to do with the partial PR.

recommendation.title: Use short trigger-critical descriptions
recommendation.body: Allow targeted edits where a bundled skill's one-line description lacks essential routing signal, but keep descriptions compact and avoid stuffing full trigger lists into frontmatter.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans bundled skill policy, ClawHub scope, and current skill-authoring docs where Peter has the strongest history signal.
